name: l86-sentinel-overread-mutant
why: L86 red: the first-scan intrusive-optional gate reads a flat 16 bytes again (the pre-96a6ad79 read) -- so an 8-byte TOptional<FName> ending an object at an unreadable page fails the read and a SET optional is dropped. A reverse of 96a6ad79 no longer builds: the refine gate added later calls SentinelBytesNeeded too.

subs.old:
int32_t need = Ubel::SentinelBytesNeeded(sf.optionalSentinel);
                if (sf.size > 0 && sf.size < need) need = sf.size;
subs.new: int32_t need = 16;   // L86 RED MUTANT: the pre-96a6ad79 flat 16-byte read
